posts.text: 🤖 AI Platform Light Origins Open-Sources Light-O1-Preview 6B Whole-Body Model Pandaily (China) · 🟢 ChatGPT · 🌏 Asia · 48m ago • Light Origins open-sourced Light-O1-Preview, a 6B model converting human video actions into robot trajectories. • Model operates under Apache-2.0 license, distinct from the company's separate LightNav-0 navigation stack. • Enables whole-body motion planning for robotics applications based on human movement priors.
